description: This file provides utility functions for generating presigned URLs for S3 objects, including viewing (GET) and uploading (PUT) videos, with environment-based configuration and validation.

methods.name: createS3ClientFromEnv
methods.description: Creates an S3Client instance configured with AWS region from environment variables.

methods.name: getBucketNameFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the S3 bucket name from environment variables.

methods.name: normalizeAndValidateS3Key
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the S3 object key string.

methods.name: inferContentType
methods.description: Infers content type based on filename extension.

methods.name: getPresignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for downloading an S3 object.

methods.name: getUploadPresignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for uploading an S3 object.
